This '''Imperial captain''' served as the commander of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] search for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Under this captain's command, the ''Executor'' failed to capture Skywalker and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the [[Kothlis asteroid field]]. Nevertheless, the captain proceeded to oversee the ''Executor'' deliver a [[Battle of Kothlis|punishing show of force]] against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]] in feigned pursuit of the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].
